topic.title: Articulated Shape, Pose, and Motion Correspondence
topic.overview: Articulated objects change shape through linked parts, making reconstruction and motion understanding inseparable from correspondence. This topic studies how to associate observed features with body parts, infer poses from incomplete views, and represent motion across different skeletons. Methods combine geometric structure, learned body models, and constraints on plausible configurations.
topic.whyItMatters: Reliable correspondence supports motion capture, reconstruction, and animation without requiring every scene to be carefully calibrated. Ambiguity remains when parts are occluded or different bodies have incompatible structures, so useful representations must express both shared function and the limits of anatomical similarity.
topic.evolution: A 1993 study formulates feature matching through joint probability densities. A-NeRF in 2021 equips a neural radiance field with a skeleton to learn shape, appearance, and refined pose from unlabeled monocular video. Recent work adds scene and manifold constraints; a 2026 framework aligns functional joints to transfer motion across different skeletal topologies.
openQuestions: How can models represent multiple plausible poses without losing physical structure?
Which motion concepts transfer between species without paired demonstrations?

papers.title: EgoSim: An Egocentric Multi-view Simulator and Real Dataset for Body-worn Cameras during Motion and Activity
papers.tldr: EgoSim and MultiEgoView provide simulated and real body-camera footage that helps train video-based 3D pose estimation for real-world use.

papers.title: emg2pose: A Large and Diverse Benchmark for Surface Electromyographic Hand Pose Estimation
papers.tldr: emg2pose provides large-scale wrist muscle recordings and hand pose labels to test generalization across users, sensor placements, and gestures.

papers.title: Estimating Ego-Body Pose from Doubly Sparse Egocentric Video Data
papers.tldr: A two-stage method completes intermittent hand trajectories and uses their uncertainty to guide full-body motion generation.

papers.title: Evaluating Multiview Object Consistency in Humans and Image Models
papers.tldr: Humans substantially outperform tested vision models at recognizing objects across viewpoints, despite correlated patterns of difficulty.

papers.title: Expressive Gaussian Human Avatars from Monocular RGB Video
papers.tldr: EVA improves human avatars learned from monocular video through better model alignment, adaptive Gaussian density control, and pixel-level confidence.

papers.title: General Articulated Objects Manipulation in Real Images via Part-Aware Diffusion Process
papers.tldr: Part-aware diffusion combines abstract 3D structure and appearance transfer to edit articulated objects in real images.

papers.title: Hamba: Single-view 3D Hand Reconstruction with Graph-guided Bi-Scanning Mamba
papers.tldr: Hamba uses graph-guided bidirectional Mamba scanning to model hand joints compactly and improve single-image 3D hand reconstruction.

papers.title: Harmony4D: A Video Dataset for In-The-Wild Close Human Interactions
papers.tldr: Harmony4D provides richly annotated multiview videos of close human interactions, exposing reconstruction weaknesses and improving a model fine-tuned on its data.

papers.title: HumanVid: Demystifying Training Data for Camera-controllable Human Image Animation
papers.tldr: HumanVid combines annotated real videos and synthetic avatars to support human image animation with control over both poses and camera movement.

papers.title: IKEA Manuals at Work: 4D Grounding of Assembly Instructions on Internet Videos
papers.tldr: IKEA Video Manuals aligns furniture parts, manuals, and assembly videos across space and time to support five assembly-related evaluation tasks.

papers.title: IMAGPose: A Unified Conditional Framework for Pose-Guided Person Generation
papers.tldr: IMAGPose unifies multi-pose and multi-view person generation through complementary feature, image, and cross-view conditioning modules.

papers.title: InterControl: Zero-shot Human Interaction Generation by Controlling Every Joint
papers.tldr: InterControl coordinates multiple generated characters through joint-distance constraints without requiring training on fixed-size group interactions.

papers.title: Learning 3D Garment Animation from Trajectories of A Piece of Cloth
papers.tldr: EUNet learns deformation energy from a piece of cloth and uses it to support more stable, physically plausible garment animation.

papers.title: Learning Interaction-aware 3D Gaussian Splatting for One-shot Hand Avatars
papers.tldr: A two-stage Gaussian Splatting framework combines learned hand priors, individual fitting, and interaction-focused refinement to create avatars from single images.

papers.title: MambaTalk: Efficient Holistic Gesture Synthesis with Selective State Space Models
papers.tldr: MambaTalk combines selective state space modeling with discrete motion priors to improve holistic gesture synthesis in subjective and objective evaluations.

papers.title: ManiPose: Manifold-Constrained Multi-Hypothesis 3D Human Pose Estimation
papers.tldr: ManiPose handles depth ambiguity with multiple plausibility-scored 3D poses constrained to remain structurally consistent.

papers.title: MoGenTS: Motion Generation based on Spatial-Temporal Joint Modeling
papers.tldr: MoGenTS represents individual joints as a two-dimensional motion token map and improves generation through spatial-temporal modeling.

papers.title: Multi-hypotheses Conditioned Point Cloud Diffusion for 3D Human Reconstruction from Occluded Images
papers.tldr: Multiple probabilistic body-shape hypotheses guide point-cloud diffusion to reconstruct detailed clothed humans from heavily occluded images.

papers.title: Muscles in Time: Learning to Understand Human Motion In-Depth by Simulating Muscle Activations
papers.tldr: MinT enriches motion-capture data with simulated muscle activations and supports learning to estimate those activations from pose sequences.

papers.title: Neural Assets: 3D-Aware Multi-Object Scene Synthesis with Image Diffusion Models
papers.tldr: Neural Assets separate object appearance from target pose to enable precise multi-object editing and recomposition with image diffusion models.

papers.title: Neural Localizer Fields for Continuous 3D Human Pose and Shape Estimation
papers.tldr: Neural Localizer Fields unify heterogeneous human-body annotations through a continuous model that predicts the 3D location of arbitrary body points.

papers.title: Neural Pose Representation Learning for Generating and Transferring Non-Rigid Object Poses
papers.tldr: The method learns transferable 3D pose representations without skeletons or correspondence supervision and uses them to generate diverse deformations.

papers.title: Pedestrian-Centric 3D Pre-collision Pose and Shape Estimation from Dashcam Perspective
papers.tldr: PVCP and PPSENet support dashcam-based reconstruction of pedestrians' 3D poses and body shapes before collisions.

papers.title: Posture-Informed Muscular Force Learning for Robust Hand Pressure Estimation
papers.tldr: PiMForce combines 3D hand posture with forearm muscle signals to improve whole-hand pressure estimation across varied interactions.

papers.title: Referring Human Pose and Mask Estimation In the Wild
papers.tldr: RefHuman and UniPHD enable text- or position-guided prediction of the pose and segmentation mask of a specified person.

papers.title: Seeing Beyond the Crop: Using Language Priors for Out-of-Bounding Box Keypoint Prediction
papers.tldr: TokenCLIPose uses language-derived keypoint context to predict human and interacting-object poses from person-focused image crops.

papers.title: Skinned Motion Retargeting with Dense Geometric Interaction Perception
papers.tldr: MeshRet transfers character motion by aligning dense surface interactions, preserving contact and preventing self-interpenetration.

papers.title: Sparse-view Pose Estimation and Reconstruction via Analysis by Generative Synthesis
papers.tldr: SparseAGS combines generative view priors with explicit pose-outlier correction to improve camera estimates and 3D reconstruction from sparse images.

papers.title: Stable-Pose: Leveraging Transformers for Pose-Guided Text-to-Image Generation
papers.tldr: Stable-Pose improves skeleton-guided image generation using progressively refined transformer attention and a loss emphasizing pose regions.

papers.title: $\text{Di}^2\text{Pose}$: Discrete Diffusion Model for Occluded 3D Human Pose Estimation
papers.tldr: Di²Pose uses pose quantization and discrete diffusion to narrow the search toward plausible three-dimensional human poses under occlusion.

papers.title: Toward Approaches to Scalability in 3D Human Pose Estimation
papers.tldr: Biomechanical pose generation and binary depth decisions jointly expand pose diversity and improve 3D pose estimation.

papers.title: CUPS: Improving Human Pose-Shape Estimators with Conformalized Deep Uncertainty
papers.tldr: CUPS jointly learns human pose estimates and uncertainty, then uses conformal calibration with coverage-gap bounds for data that are not fully exchangeable.

papers.title: ExtPose: Robust and Coherent Pose Estimation by Extending ViTs
papers.tldr: ExtPose adds structured 2D pose evidence and temporal attention to ViTs without extra parameters, improving human and hand pose estimation.

papers.title: How to Move Your Dragon: Text-to-Motion Synthesis for Large-Vocabulary Objects
papers.tldr: Text annotations, rig augmentation, and adaptable diffusion models enable motion generation for diverse skeletal structures, including unseen objects.

papers.title: Semantics-aware Test-time Adaptation for 3D Human Pose Estimation
papers.tldr: A semantics-aware motion prior and missing-pose completion improve test-time adaptation for three-dimensional human pose estimation.

papers.title: 3D Human Pose Estimation with Muscles
papers.tldr: MusclePose combines motion equations and muscle modeling to estimate competitive 3D poses and plausible human kinetics from monocular video.

papers.title: Advanced Sign Language Video Generation with Compressed and Quantized Multi-Condition Tokenization
papers.tldr: SignViP translates text into compact tokens encoding detailed pose and hand information to guide higher-quality sign language video generation.

papers.title: BEDLAM2.0: Synthetic humans and cameras in motion
papers.tldr: BEDLAM2.0 expands synthetic human and camera motion data and improves training for reconstructing human movement in world coordinates.

papers.title: Care-PD: A Multi-Site Anonymized Clinical Dataset for Parkinson’s Disease Gait Assessment
papers.tldr: Care-PD combines anonymized gait data from eight clinical centers to improve movement representation learning and Parkinson’s severity assessment.

papers.title: Coarse-to-Fine 3D Part Assembly via Semantic Super-Parts and Symmetry-Aware Pose Estimation
papers.tldr: CFPA combines semantic grouping, geometric refinement, and symmetry-aware training to assemble accurate and diverse 3D objects.

papers.title: CoDA: Coordinated Diffusion Noise Optimization for Whole-Body Manipulation of Articulated Objects
papers.tldr: CoDA coordinates separate body and hand diffusion models through noise optimization to generate precise whole-body interactions with articulated objects.

papers.title: Cycle-Sync: Robust Global Camera Pose Estimation through Enhanced Cycle-Consistent Synchronization
papers.tldr: Cycle-Sync uses cycle-consistent measurements and robust estimation to recover camera poses globally without bundle adjustment.

papers.title: DGH: Dynamic Gaussian Hair
papers.tldr: Dynamic Gaussian Hair learns coherent hair motion and view-consistent appearance from data for integration into animated avatars.

papers.title: DIPO: Dual-State Images Controlled Articulated Object Generation Powered by Diverse Data
papers.tldr: DIPO combines images of two object states, diffusion, and connectivity reasoning to generate articulated 3D objects.

papers.title: Don’t call it privacy-preserving or human-centric pose estimation if you don’t measure privacy
papers.tldr: This position paper argues that human pose estimation needs measurable privacy evaluation to substantiate privacy-preserving and human-centric claims.

papers.title: Doodle to Detect: A Goofy but Powerful Approach to Skeleton-based Hand Gesture Recognition
papers.tldr: SKETCH turns raw hand-skeleton sequences into graph images while preserving motion magnitudes to improve gesture recognition.

papers.title: Dual-Res Tandem Mamba-3D: Bilateral Breast Lesion Detection and Classification on Non-contrast Chest CT
papers.tldr: DRT-M3D combines two image resolutions and bilateral breast information to detect lesions and classify cancer in existing non-contrast chest CT scans.

papers.title: EgoExOR: An Ego-Exo-Centric Operating Room Dataset for Surgical Activity Understanding
papers.tldr: EgoExOR combines wearable and external sensor views with detailed interaction annotations for studying activity in two emulated surgical procedures.

papers.title: EverybodyDance: Bipartite Graph–Based Identity Correspondence for Multi-Character Animation
papers.tldr: EverybodyDance trains multi-character animation models to preserve identity through an explicit graph of reference-to-generated character matches.

papers.title: From Pose to Muscle: Multimodal Learning for Piano Hand Muscle Electromyography
papers.tldr: PianoKPM introduces a multimodal dataset and model for hand-muscle EMG inference, evaluating adaptation across users, tasks, and training-data amounts.

papers.title: GeneMAN: Generalizable Single-Image 3D Human Reconstruction from Multi-Source Human Data
papers.tldr: GeneMAN combines human-specific diffusion priors and staged refinement to reconstruct detailed 3D people from single photographs.

papers.title: Generalizable Hand-Object Modeling from Monocular RGB Images via 3D Gaussians
papers.tldr: HOGS uses 3D Gaussians to separate hand-object geometry from changing appearance, improving reconstruction and generalization in evaluated settings.

papers.title: Geo-Sign: Hyperbolic Contrastive Regularisation for Geometrically Aware Sign Language Translation
papers.tldr: Geo-Sign uses hyperbolic geometry to structure skeletal motion features and improve sign language translation.

papers.title: GSAlign: Geometric and Semantic Alignment Network for Aerial-Ground Person Re-Identification
papers.tldr: GSAlign improves aerial-ground person matching by jointly correcting feature geometry and emphasizing visible body regions.

papers.title: HO-Cap: A Capture System and Dataset for 3D Reconstruction and Pose Tracking of Hand-Object Interaction
papers.tldr: HO-Cap combines accessible capture hardware and semiautomatic annotation to collect 3D hand-object interaction demonstrations.

papers.title: HOComp: Interaction-Aware Human-Object Composition
papers.tldr: HOComp combines interaction-specific pose guidance and appearance preservation to create more coherent human-object image compositions.

papers.title: HumanCrafter: Synergizing Generalizable Human Reconstruction and Semantic 3D Segmentation
papers.tldr: HumanCrafter jointly reconstructs a 3D human and labels body parts from one image, improving both tasks through shared geometric and semantic information.

papers.title: Interactive Anomaly Detection for Articulated Objects via Motion Anticipation
papers.tldr: The method detects functional faults by manipulating articulated objects and comparing their observed motion with motion learned from normal objects.

papers.title: MEgoHand: Multimodal Egocentric Hand-Object Interaction Motion Generation
papers.tldr: MEgoHand combines visual-language interpretation, depth estimation, and trajectory generation to produce accurate first-person hand-object motions across diverse evaluated settings.

papers.title: Mitigating Occlusions in Virtual Try-On via A Simple-Yet-Effective Mask-Free Framework
papers.tldr: A mask-free virtual try-on framework uses two targeted operations to reduce clothing remnants and implausible body structures.

papers.title: MPMAvatar: Learning 3D Gaussian Avatars with Accurate and Robust Physics-Based Dynamics
papers.tldr: MPMAvatar combines tailored garment physics with Gaussian rendering to produce accurate, robust human-avatar animations.

papers.title: NoPo-Avatar: Generalizable and Animatable Avatars from Sparse Inputs without Human Poses
papers.tldr: NoPo-Avatar reconstructs animatable human avatars from sparse images without pose inputs, improving results when ground-truth poses are unavailable.

papers.title: OctoNet: A Large-Scale Multi-Modal Dataset for Human Activity Understanding Grounded in Motion-Captured 3D Pose Labels
papers.tldr: OctoNet aligns 12 sensing modalities with motion-captured 3D poses to support human activity understanding across sensors and viewpoints.

papers.title: OmniTry: Virtual Try-On Anything without Masks
papers.tldr: OmniTry learns mask-free placement from unpaired portraits, then uses paired examples to preserve the appearance of diverse wearable objects.

papers.title: Orient Anything V2: Unifying Orientation and Rotation Understanding
papers.tldr: Orient Anything V2 explicitly models rotational symmetry and relative rotations, achieving leading zero-shot results across 11 benchmarks.

papers.title: Orientation Matters: Making 3D Generative Models Orientation-Aligned
papers.tldr: An orientation-aligned dataset enables fine-tuned 3D generators to produce consistently oriented objects and support orientation estimation and rotation control.

papers.title: PandaPose: 3D Human Pose Lifting from a Single Image via Propagating 2D Pose Prior to 3D Anchor Space
papers.tldr: PandaPose combines 3D joint anchors, visual evidence, and depth cues to improve single-image 3D pose estimation.

papers.title: PolyPose: Deformable 2D/3D Registration via Polyrigid Transformations
papers.tldr: PolyPose uses the piecewise-rigid nature of skeletal motion to align preoperative 3D scans with as few as two X-rays in experiments.

papers.title: Pose Splatter: A 3D Gaussian Splatting Model for Quantifying Animal Pose and Appearance
papers.tldr: Pose Splatter models detailed animal pose and appearance without manual annotations or per-frame optimization.

papers.title: Puppeteer: Rig and Animate Your 3D Models
papers.tldr: Puppeteer automatically predicts skeletons and skinning weights, then generates efficient, temporally coherent animations for diverse 3D objects.

papers.title: PyraMotion: Attentional Pyramid-Structured Motion Integration for Co-Speech 3D Gesture Synthesis
papers.tldr: PyraMotion adaptively combines motion features across temporal scales to generate more natural and expressive full-body gestures from audio.

papers.title: RAPTR: Radar-based 3D Pose Estimation using Transformer
papers.tldr: RAPTR learns radar-based 3D human poses from bounding boxes and 2D keypoints, reporting lower joint errors without detailed 3D keypoint labels.

papers.title: REArtGS: Reconstructing and Generating Articulated Objects via 3D Gaussian Splatting with Geometric and Motion Constraints
papers.tldr: REArtGS combines geometric and kinematic constraints on 3D Gaussians to reconstruct articulated objects and generate surfaces in unseen configurations.

papers.title: Rectified Point Flow: Generic Point Cloud Pose Estimation
papers.tldr: Rectified Point Flow unifies point-cloud registration and shape assembly by learning point motions from which poses are recovered.

papers.title: RFMPose: Generative Category-level Object Pose Estimation via Riemannian Flow Matching
papers.tldr: RFMPose uses Riemannian Flow Matching to estimate object poses while respecting geometry and addressing symmetry-induced ambiguity.

papers.title: Rig3R: Rig-Aware Conditioning and Discovery for 3D Reconstruction
papers.tldr: Rig3R uses or infers multi-camera rig structure to jointly reconstruct scenes, estimate poses, and discover camera arrangements in one forward pass.

papers.title: SceneDesigner: Controllable Multi-Object Image Generation with 9-DoF Pose Manipulation
papers.tldr: SceneDesigner combines geometric pose conditioning, rebalanced training, and specialized sampling to control multiple objects’ positions, sizes, and orientations.

papers.title: SGAR: Structural Generative Augmentation for 3D Human Motion Retrieval
papers.tldr: SGAR decomposes motion into body-part concepts to improve motion-text alignment, with reported gains in retrieval and transfer to recognition and generation.

papers.title: ShoeFit: A New Dataset and Dual-image-stream DiT Framework for Virtual Footwear Try-On
papers.tldr: ShoeFit pairs a multi-view footwear dataset with a dual-stream diffusion transformer to improve viewpoint alignment, texture preservation, and color fidelity.

papers.title: SRHand: Super-Resolving Hand Images and 3D Shapes via View/Pose-aware Neural Image Representations and Explicit Meshes
papers.tldr: SRHand jointly enhances low-resolution hand images and explicit meshes to reconstruct fine details consistently across viewpoints and poses.

papers.title: SyncHuman: Synchronizing 2D and 3D Generative Models for Single-view Human Reconstruction
papers.tldr: SyncHuman aligns 2D multiview and native 3D generators, then transfers image detail onto shapes for single-image human reconstruction.

papers.title: ToF-IP: Time-of-Flight Enhanced Sparse Inertial Poser for Real-time Human Motion Capture
papers.tldr: ToF-IP adds direct distance sensing and tailored sensor integration to improve sparse-inertial full-body motion tracking.

papers.title: Towards Dynamic 3D Reconstruction of Hand-Instrument Interaction in Ophthalmic Surgery
papers.tldr: OphNet-3D provides large-scale surgical motion data and models that improve reconstruction of interacting hands and instruments.

papers.title: Towards Generalizable 3D Human Pose Estimation via Ensembles on Flat Loss Landscapes
papers.tldr: Adaptive loss-landscape smoothing and an ensemble of diverse solutions improve 3D human pose estimation generalization across tested architectures.

papers.title: Unified 2D-3D Discrete Priors for Noise-Robust and Calibration-Free Multiview 3D Human Pose Estimation
papers.tldr: UniCodebook combines discrete pose priors with continuous features to improve noise robustness in calibration-free multiview 3D pose estimation.

papers.title: URDF-Anything: Constructing Articulated Objects with 3D Multimodal Language Model
papers.tldr: URDF-Anything jointly reconstructs object parts and motion parameters from point clouds and text to build articulated digital twins.

papers.title: VASA-3D: Lifelike Audio-Driven Gaussian Head Avatars from a Single Image
papers.tldr: VASA-3D turns a single portrait into an expressive, audio-driven 3D head avatar with fast free-viewpoint rendering.

papers.title: Whole-Body Conditioned Egocentric Video Prediction
papers.tldr: A conditional video model uses structured whole-body pose trajectories to predict first-person visual consequences of human actions.

papers.title: CRAG: Can 3D Generative Models Help 3D Assembly?
papers.tldr: CRAG jointly assembles 3D parts and generates complete shapes, using each process to improve the other.

papers.title: DGG-HMR: Multi-Person Human Mesh Recovery with Depth-Guided Geometric Anchoring
papers.tldr: DGG-HMR uses explicit per-person depth anchors to improve multi-person body reconstruction and depth ordering from a single image.

papers.title: Direct 3D-Aware Object Insertion via Decomposed Visual Proxies
papers.tldr: DIRECT separates appearance, geometry, and scene guidance to insert reference objects with explicit user control over their three-dimensional pose.

papers.title: DisPOSE: Projected Polystochastic Diffusion for Self-Supervised Multi-View 3D Human Pose Estimation
papers.tldr: DisPOSE uses constrained diffusion to match people across camera views before reconstructing 3D skeletons, achieving strong self-supervised results with few pseudo-labels.

papers.title: Doppler Prompting for Stable mmWave-based Human Pose Estimation
papers.tldr: PULSE screens Doppler motion cues before using them to improve the accuracy and temporal stability of radar-based human pose estimates.

papers.title: Dual Quaternion SE(3) Synchronization with Recovery Guarantees
papers.tldr: A dual quaternion pose-synchronization algorithm combines efficient refinement with recovery bounds and linear error contraction down to a noise-dependent threshold.

papers.title: EgoTactile: Learning Grasp Pressure for Everyday Objects from Egocentric Video
papers.tldr: EgoTactile pairs egocentric video with full-hand pressure labels and uses conditional diffusion to infer plausible grasp patterns.

papers.title: Generalizable and Actionable Parts Pose Estimation with Symmetry Annotation-Free Learning Strategy
papers.tldr: SAFAG combines progressive pose refinement with self-supervised symmetry prediction to estimate actionable part poses without symmetry annotations.

papers.title: Glimpse: Geometry Learning of Multi-scale Structural Priors for 3D Pose Estimation
papers.tldr: Glimpse combines joint and limb features with a shared three-dimensional reference to improve single-image pose estimation under occlusion and complex articulation.

papers.title: HOI-PAGE: Zero-Shot Human-Object Interaction Generation with Part Affordance Guidance
papers.tldr: HOI-PAGE uses structured reasoning about interacting body and object parts to improve zero-shot generation of realistic 4D interactions.

papers.title: Hyperbolic Hierarchical Alignment for Video-Based Visible-Infrared Person Re-Identification
papers.tldr: HHA uses hyperbolic representations to organize temporal variation and align person identities across visible and infrared videos.

papers.title: Interleaved Selective State Space Models for Efficient WiFi-Based 3D Multi-Person Pose Estimation
papers.tldr: WiFi-Mamba uses coupled state-space streams and persistent memory to improve WiFi-based 3D pose estimation with far fewer parameters.

papers.title: iTryOn: Mastering Interactive Video Virtual Try-On with Spatial-Semantic Guidance
papers.tldr: iTryOn combines 3D hand guidance and timed action descriptions to generate virtual clothing changes that preserve active human-garment interactions.

papers.title: MotionGRPO: Overcoming Low Intra-Group Diversity in GRPO-Based Egocentric Motion Recovery
papers.tldr: MotionGRPO improves body-motion reconstruction with detailed rewards and noise injection that strengthens learning from grouped diffusion samples.

papers.title: PhysHanDI: Physics-Based Reconstruction of Hand-Deformable Object Interactions
papers.tldr: PhysHanDI couples hand reconstruction with physical deformation simulation to improve reconstruction and prediction of hand–deformable-object interactions.

papers.title: Pose-ICL: 3D-Aware In-Context Learning for Pose-Controllable Subject Customization
papers.tldr: Pose-ICL uses paired image-pose references and explicit 3D positional information to improve subject pose control without subject-specific tuning.

papers.title: Position: Human-Centric Vision Requires Topological Generalization Beyond Fixed Skeletal Topologies
papers.tldr: Human pose systems should adapt skeletal structure to each person and explicitly distinguish absent anatomy from hidden anatomy.

papers.title: Semantic-Aware Motion Encoding for Topology-Agnostic Character Animation
papers.tldr: A shared motion representation aligns joints by function, enabling reconstruction, text-to-motion generation, and zero-shot transfer across species.

papers.title: StructMamPose: From Sequential Perception to Structural Reasoning for 3D Human Pose Estimation
papers.tldr: StructMamPose improves monocular 3D pose estimation by anchoring state updates to pose structure and using internal coordinate rotations to support depth reasoning.

papers.title: WildActor: Unconstrained Identity-Preserving Video Generation
papers.tldr: WildActor combines a large human-video dataset with adaptive reference conditioning to preserve full-body identity across changing views and motion.
